processFlow.title: How work becomes action
processFlow.subtitle: One incoming signal moves through context, decision support, and human-owned follow-up.
processFlow.caption: The capability is useful because it connects signals to accountable action.

footprint.title: Support footprint
footprint.subtitle: Reusable patterns matter when the same workflow appears across teams, systems, or regions.
footprint.caption: Same pattern, repeated safely.

architecture.title: How the support capability works
architecture.subtitle: Read-only evidence goes in; support-ready material comes out.

slides.label: 1 / context
slides.title: This is the world the capability supports
slides.headline: Support work is connected to real operational flow, not just screens.
slides.supportingLine: A signal becomes context gathering, decision support, a reviewable artifact, and accountable human action.
slides.speakerNotes: Start with the operational context. The audience only needs enough background to understand why support quality matters.

slides.label: 2 / proof
slides.title: The capability is already producing support-ready artifacts
slides.headline: Evidence in. Human-reviewed action out.
slides.supportingLine: The system gathers context, prepares the next support step, and keeps people in control.
slides.guardrailLine: Guardrails: read-only by default; no autonomous deploys; no restarts; audit trail.
slides.speakerNotes: This is the credibility slide. Show the system, the proof artifacts, and the guardrails together.

slides.label: 3 / ambition
slides.title: The dream: a reusable AI support teammate
slides.headline: A guarded pattern for making operational knowledge available exactly when teams need it.
slides.closingLine: Do not wait for the playbook. Build it through real support work.
slides.speakerNotes: Close by widening from the first use case to the repeatable operating model.
